title: Kiritani Haruka — Drowning In Dazzlement〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Event: Screaming?! Welcome to the Forest of Wolves!

rows.Line: After school
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-C

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Today, we'll once again be doing preparations for the School Festival!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: To start, I'd like to ask those who have brought plushies, animal goods and such to gather with me.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Let's all do our best today!

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Okay...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, Ichi!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We should ask everyone to see what they think of the things we brought!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Right. But it'll probably need to wait a bit since there might be some people who brought plushies.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hoshino, do you have a second?
I brought some plushies with me...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You did?! Thank you so much, Kiritani!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: To my surprise, not many others did, so I really appreciate it.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
As for me, I brought mostly penguins.
I hope that won't warp the image of our cafe...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, Haruka, can I take a look at your plushies?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Of course.
They're right here.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wow! So many penguins!
And they're all really adorable!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Our animal cafe's gonna look so cute!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: At the same time, we're going to need some other animals. I'm worried that our animal cafe's going to turn into a penguin cafe.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(Oh, they also brought some bags.
But it doesn't look like they're full of plushies...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Did you two also bring some animal goods?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I bought some animal ear headbands after Saki suggested that we should. I'm a little embarrassed about wearing one, but shall we try them on together?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Animal headbands?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Ta-daa!
Here, have a look!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh, they're animal ear headbands.
I'm seeing rabbit ears, dog ears, cat ears... They're all very cute.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I know, right?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki was saying how we should dress up as animals since our classroom's going to be filled with them.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That makes sense. We're doing an animal cafe, so it might be fun for everyone in class to be dressed as different ones.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah. So, we decided to go around to some party goods stores and buy an assortment of things.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. Having everyone wear these adorably furry ears is such a great idea if I do say so myself♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
We even got some tails!
Hang on... Here! You can be a doggy or a kitty!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh, they're really fluffy too.
They almost feel like the real thing.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wanna try one on? All you really have to do is put on a headband and the belt for the tail!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay, let's try some on.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Awesome! Which animals should we pick?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hmm... Kiritani likes penguins, but...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: They didn't have any penguin headbands...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
So... What else would suit her...?
Something simple might actually be the best option...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Then, how about a cat?
I bought a set for a black cat that looked fairly straightforward.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, I bet she'll look great as a black kitty! Haruka, if you will!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay, one second.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
The ears should be good here...
As for my tail... How do I look?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Perfect!
They both suit you really well.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Now, Haruka, try waiting tables like a kitty cat♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: L-Like a cat?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: A cat, huh... M-Meow...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: W-Welcome...meow...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Whoa! That was amazing!!!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
It was?
Then, I'll try a little harder this time.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Try harder...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
“Welcomeow♪
What would you like to have meow?”

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Um... Is something wrong, you two?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Y-You're...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Blindingly bright!!!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: How do I describe it?! It's like we were just swept away by a torrent of happiness and sunshine!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Y-Yeah... This must be what Minori's always talking about. Kiritani's idol aura...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. You're exaggerating.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
No, we aren't!
We talk to each other every day, so we're used to being around you. But what about our customers?! They might not be able to handle your power!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I agree... Also, I'm not sure I could do that even if someone asked me to...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, right... Some people might not feel all that comfortable with talking like a cat or dog.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: The ears and tails are already plenty cute, so why don't we just talk normally to our customers?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I agree.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you for trying them on for us, Kiritani. You taught us quite a lot just now.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, totally!
And we got to see you as an adorable kitty cat! Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
You're welcome.
I'm glad that I could help.
